scope: Native compiled-worker deployment adaptation of already-mapped SDK functions; no additional inventory credit

api_mapping._endpoint_input: shared endpoint formatter with native command selection
api_mapping.build_manifest: coordinator v1 shape retained, pythonVersion used only for existing image family

verified_contracts: Same uploaded and finalized manifest, existing lookup/upload/activate/reconcile ordering, anonymous upload
Resource symbols, explicit secrets and Linux x86_64 target preflight before remote mutations
Queue/API endpoint images, native command, authoritative runtime kind and selected environment
Native task preflight rejection before mutation until coordinator task launch is wired
Prebuilt/warm/cold launcher selection, delayed mount, missing worker/member, malformed wait and literal argument forwarding
Cold launcher extracts to a separate bootstrap copy; stdin tar input avoids remote colon-path syntax
linux_ci_contract: Actual uploaded ELF worker executes the generated endpoint command, fully extracts via Rust bootstrap and serves its bundled asset; Linux x86_64 only
native_adaptations: Caller compiles a Linux x86_64 executable; header check does not validate full ELF or dynamic libraries
Built-in Python-version image tags provide existing OS images; no Python interpreter or installer runs
Custom images require POSIX utilities, compatible libraries and a command-compatible entrypoint
Prelaunch errors use stderr/exit; structured bootstrap error responders require the worker to start
Blocking packaging finishes if already running at cancellation; later cloud calls do not run
pending_contracts: Cargo/cross-compilation and native CLI build/deploy commands
Native live source loading and worker dispatch
